Límite de piezas por tipo en cada página: Limit of pieces per type on each page during the campaign. The first row is the default quota for every page; you can set a different quota on a page. Empty = no limit (or the default one). Once the quota is reached, editus won't publish more pieces of that type on that page.
La campaña no tiene páginas. Elige sus m: The campaign has no pages. Choose its media outlets in Edit campaign or wait for outlets to sign up.
Los tipos de pieza (columnas) se cambian: Piece types (columns) are changed in Edit campaign → Media plan.
Cada subcampaña agrupa las publicaciones: Each sub-campaign groups the posts about the same content (e.g. «Dengue»). When you publish in the campaign you choose the sub-campaign, so you get metrics per sub-campaign and for the whole campaign. The program and subprogram are the ones shown on the outlets' certificate.
Ej: Programa 6. ETV: Dengue y Fiebre Ama: E.g. Programa 6. ETV: Dengue y Fiebre Amarilla
Si cambias el programa o el subprograma: If you change a sub-campaign's program or subprogram, its posts and the certificates are updated. If you delete a sub-campaign, its posts become «no sub-campaign».

Cuentan las piezas publicadas o en cola: Published or queued pieces with a piece type are counted. A piece posted on Facebook and Instagram at once counts only once.
Esta campaña es un plan de medios: This campaign is a media plan
Activa la inscripción de medios con enla: Turns on media outlet sign-up by link, the signed certificate, sub-campaigns, piece quotas per page and the metrics dashboard. Other campaigns work as usual.
Guarda la campaña para configurar sus su: Save the campaign to set up its sub-campaigns, quotas and dashboard.
Al publicar en la campaña eliges la subc: When you publish in the campaign you choose the sub-campaign and piece type. Quotas are set per type.
Asigna a cada publicación su subcampaña: Assign each post its sub-campaign and piece type. This fills the sub-campaign metrics, the quotas and each outlet's certificate.
